rationale: The description meaningfully states SaaS performance monitoring and automated remediation: it assesses availability, health, and end-user experience and generates automations to remediate issues. These are conventional functions, with no affirmative AI/ML signal.
evidence_spans: securely gathers intelligence about data, application, and voice performance
continuously assesses the availability, health, and precise experience of your end users and to generate automations that remediate issues.
conflict_response: The labeler's concern about vague “intelligence” and automation wording does not outweigh the explicit monitoring targets and remediation behavior. The description identifies concrete SaaS functions, and routine automation is not AI by itself, so the supported non-AI judgment is retained.
